name: Sky Temple
theme: Capture active Temples to fire laser barrages at enemy structures while defending against Temple Guardians.
firstObjective: Warning at 2:30, spawns at 3:00 (~2:00 cooldown after a Temple phase ends)
spawnPattern: 3 fixed Temples (Top, Mid & Bottom): 1st phase activates Top & Mid together, 2nd phase activates Bottom alone, then cycles in set patterns

mechanic.title: Temple Control & Laser Bombardment
mechanic.description: Stand inside an active Temple circle to charge its laser and fire beams at nearby enemy structures while periodically spawning Temple Guardians that attack Heroes standing on the pad. Each Temple can fire up to a fixed shot budget (including a final multi-shot burst) before deactivating or running out of shots.

camps.name: Siege Giants (2 Camps)
camps.notes: Located in the mid-left and bottom-right areas. Ranged boulder throwers that apply steady lane siege pressure—great to push bottom lane while contesting Top/Mid Temples.

camps.name: Bruisers / Knights (2 Camps)
camps.notes: Located near top-left and top-right. Durable melee mercenaries with a Spell Armor aura that create top-side pressure around Bottom Temple phases.

camps.name: Boss / Sand Golem (1 Camp)
camps.notes: Located in the bottom-mid alcove. Uses sand-tornado knockbacks and heavy slams to push bottom lane as a potent late-game objective.

strategy: Sky Temple is a three-lane macro battleground with predictable early objective rotations: Top and Mid activate first, followed by Bottom alone on the second wave. Heroes with global mobility (Falstad, Dehaka, Brightwing) or strong zone control excel at holding pads against Guardians and pokes, and capturing Siege/Bruiser camps opposite an active Temple forces enemies into split-map trade-offs.
notes: Temple Guardians deal heavy damage to Heroes standing inside the pad and can easily catch low-HP or overextended defenders off guard—clear or kite Guardians cleanly while holding the circle, and watch for Boss/camp pushes during multi-Temple phases.
